title: timeline.build
description: Constructs a normalized forensic timeline from case evidence sources (disk, memory, logs). Outputs structured JSON-Lines with de-duplicated events sorted by timestamp.

case_id.description: UUID v4 case identifier from case.open.

source_filter.description: Restrict timeline to specific evidence source type. Default: all.

since.description: Optional ISO 8601 start timestamp. Events before this are excluded.

until.description: Optional ISO 8601 end timestamp. Events after this are excluded.

inputSchema.description: Case identifier required; time window and source filters optional.

timeline_path.description: Absolute path to generated timeline file (JSON-Lines format).

event_count.description: Number of timeline events after de-duplication and filtering.

tool_used.description: SIFT tool that generated the timeline.

sources_processed.description: Evidence source types actually included in output.

outputSchema.description: Timeline metadata and reference to generated JSON-Lines file.

x-mcp-capability.name: timeline.build
x-mcp-capability.description: Construct normalized forensic timeline from case evidence.
constraints: No shell access; subprocess calls whitelisted only
Events must be sorted by timestamp
Duplicates must be removed before output
